question: Pitt’s India Act of 1784 established which of the following bodies?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Board of Control**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Pitt's India Act of 1784 was introduced to address defects in the Regulating Act of 1773 and strengthen British control over Indian territories.
 
• It established the **Board of Control**, which was responsible for overseeing civil, military, and revenue affairs in India.
 
• The Board of Control consisted of six members, including the Chancellor of the Exchequer and the Secretary of State.
 
• It brought a dual system of governance by creating a distinction between political and commercial functions of the East India Company.
 
• The Act strengthened the British government's authority over the East India Company while allowing the company to retain its trading privileges.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Regulating Act of 1773:**

 
 
• This was the first attempt by the British government to regulate the affairs of the East India Company in India.
 
• It established the position of the Governor-General of Bengal (first being Warren Hastings).
 
• It created a council of four members to assist the Governor-General.
 
• The Act also introduced a Supreme Court in Calcutta for judicial administration.
 
 
 
• **Pitt's India Act of 1784:**
 
 
• It introduced a dual government structure between the Crown and the East India Company.
 
• The Crown controlled political and military affairs through the Board of Control, while the Company managed commercial operations.
 
• This Act laid the foundation for British imperial control over India.
 
 
 
• **Impact of Pitt's India Act:**
 
 
• Strengthened the British government's influence in India and curtailed the autonomy of the East India Company.
 
• It marked a significant shift towards centralized governance in British India.
 
• The Act paved the way for future legislative measures to consolidate British control in India.
 
 
 
• **Supreme Court of Calcutta:**
 
 
• Established under the Regulating Act of 1773.
 
• It was the first British court in India with jurisdiction over British citizens and company officials.
 
• Its establishment highlighted the growing need for judicial reforms under British rule.
